title: Generating 3D Game Assets with ChatGPT & Shap-E
author: fisj

comments.author: LostInSpace2981
comments.body:
Very cool, but a shame how limited Shape-E appears. I wonder how difficult it would be to fine tune or otherwise enhance. 

Also inb4 "give it another X months!"

replies.author: fisj
replies.body: Yeah the difficulty here is that 3d model datasets are orders of magnitude smaller than imagery. Now that people know the value of data, its even harder to get. Theres still lots of people working on 3D generation, cause everyone knows how valuable it would be.

replies.author: LostInSpace2981
replies.body:
IIRC there was an architecture using SD as a first pass for geometry generation. I guess this is not that.
